base.comment: Barely-there lift so a control, such as an input, reads as a surface.

hover.comment: A raised surface lifting under the pointer.

base.comment: A card resting on the page: a soft shadow on every edge, so it stands out without a border.

hover.comment: A clickable card lifting under the pointer.

floating.comment: Menus, popovers and tooltips that float above the content.

overlay.comment: Dialogs, drawers and sheets that sit above everything else.

sunken.comment: A well pressed into the page, such as the track of a segmented control.
